question.text: Iodine is a solid and sublimes at ordinary temperature. This is because of:

options.text: weak van der Waals forces between  <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">I</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math>  molecules

solution.text: <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">I</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math>  is solid and sublimes at ordinary temperature because of weak vanderwaal's force between  <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">I</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math>  molecules.
